1. Sous chef finalists - Abebe and Hiroshi share tasting notes from Tuesday's stage, then we pick who gets the offer (and a backup)

3. Interview schedule for next week - Nico to confirm who covers which shifts so the kitchen isn't short
4. Onboarding plan - Hector + Omar, who trains the new folks before opening

Please bring your scorecards filled in. If you can't make it, send me your vote on #1 beforehand!

- Gift Aid workflow and reporting dashboards (Vera)

- Q&A and pricing tiers, Rosa to lead
After vendor drop off we stay for shortlist decision go/no-go.
